verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no product-native automations, schedules, or background agents that run on their own. The API's 120+ actions and the MCP server are building blocks or user-triggered tools, not autonomous automations. The WHOIS Watchlist and API-placed backorders are adjacent features, not configurable background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
